story_description: Implement the hooks builder pipeline, canvas, and inspector views.
task_description: Users need a visual drag-and-drop canvas to arrange hook nodes and draw connections between them.
atom_description: Users need a visual drag-and-drop canvas to arrange hook nodes and draw connections between them.
problem_statement: Users need a visual drag-and-drop canvas to arrange hook nodes and draw connections between them.
scope_in: Canvas view with drag-drop support; node placement; connection drawing; zoom/pan; grid background
Implement HooksCanvas.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Node rendering (HookNodeView); connection rendering (HookConnectionView); node configuration
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Canvas can be arbitrarily large with scroll
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must support 50+ nodes without performance degradation
Connections drawn as Bezier curves
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
At least one event node per graph
UpdatedInput only under PreToolUse or PermissionRequest with allow
Stop gate only under Stop or SubagentStop with loop safety
Conflict resolution: continue false wins, deny beats allow, ask beats allow, PostToolUse block forces remediation
Exit 0 success, stdout visible in verbose; UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart may inject into context
Exit 2 blocks with error handling per event
Other exit codes are non-blocking and continue execution
Event nodes: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Filter nodes: Matcher and Predicate
Action nodes: Command, Prompt, Agent
Control nodes: Decision Allow Deny Ask, Permission Decision, Block with Reason, Continue or Stop
Transformation nodes: Updated Input, Additional Context, System Message
Utility nodes: Logger, Export Trace, Rate limit or Debounce
Left panel node palette with Events, Filters, Actions, Utilities
Center panel canvas with pan, zoom, and grid background
Right panel inspector with node properties, tooltips, and validation errors
Top bar actions: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export
Space plus drag to pan canvas
Cmd plus scroll to zoom
Cmd C and Cmd V to copy and paste nodes
Delete to remove node
Cmd S to save, Cmd Enter to test run, Cmd Z to undo, Cmd Shift Z to redo
Cmd I to focus inspector, M to toggle minimap
functional_requirements: Support all hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
Support node taxonomy for events, filters, actions, control, transformation, and utility nodes.
Persist graph with nodes and edges and validate against semantic rules.
api_contracts: Output: Updates pipeline as user drags
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Idle saved state with no unsaved changes
Dirty state with unsaved changes and save enabled
Validating state during schema and semantic checks
Error state with validation errors and save disabled
Saving and Saved states with success toast
Discard confirm modal when leaving with unsaved changes
ui_interactions: Drag nodes from palette to canvas and connect ports to create edges.
Select node to edit config in inspector with tooltips and examples.
Run test execution and display validation results.
ui_copy: Section headers are localized and match the category name.
Control labels match the setting names listed in functional requirements.
Top bar buttons: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export.
Inspector shows short tooltip and long learn more text for each node.
edge_cases: Node dragged off screen - canvas auto-scrolls
Very zoomed out - nodes still clickable
failure_modes: Gesture conflict - prioritize node drag over pan
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
